title: A Russian, a Brazilian, and a German Walk into a Bar, Ask the Same Question-- And Get Three Different Answers: Profiling LLM Perspective Diversity on Contested Topics
abstract: arXiv:2610.34278v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models(LLMs) have shown strong performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but many real-world queries involve subjectivity, disagreement, and conflicting evidence. Most existing benchmarks for such queries remain English-centric, overlooking the vast diversity of perspectives held by users worldwide. To systematically study how LLM perspectives vary across languages, we curate PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset of globally contested topics covering 18 languages, and propose ROOTS, a framework that profiles linguistic, perspective, and framing diversity. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models covering both open-source and proprietary families at varying scales, establishing that LLMs hedge their answers in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages. translated_title: 一个俄罗斯人、一个巴西人和一个德国人走进酒吧，问了同样的问题——却得到三种不同的回答：对大语言模型在争议话题上观点多样性的分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在具有可验证答案的任务上表现出强大的能力，但许多现实世界中的查询涉及主观性、分歧以及相互矛盾的证据。现有针对此类查询的基准测试大多以英语为中心，忽视了全球用户所持观点的巨大多样性。为了系统研究LLM的观点如何随语言变化，我们构建了PerspectivesQA——一个经过人工验证、涵盖18种语言的全球争议话题多语言数据集，并提出了ROOTS框架，用于刻画语言、观点和表述方式的多样性。我们评估了涵盖开源与专有系列、不同规模共八个模型，发现LLM在英语中倾向于含糊其辞，但在低资源语言中则会明确表态。更大的模型能保持更一致的跨语言世界观，而较小的模型则更容易被动摇。所有模型还表现出……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了涵盖18种语言的争议话题多语言数据集PerspectivesQA和ROOTS分析框架，揭示出大语言模型在英语中回答含糊保守，但在低资源语言中会明确表态，且其观点多样性随模型规模呈系统性差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PerspectivesQA, a manually verified multilingual dataset covering contested topics in 18 languages, and the ROOTS framework, revealing that LLMs hedge in English but commit to positions in lower-resource languages, with larger models maintaining more consistent cross-lingual worldviews.
